answer: Issue every agent a TPM-bound identity card: one chip, one identity, no duplicates. Enrolment passes a single jetty gate: the chip signs once, the network binds its key to one record, verified in 2 seconds. New cards serve a 30-day glacier probation, earning nothing while peers review 20 first tasks. A card caught serving two identities is revoked in 24 hours and its 500 POA stake slashed, its dead key published to all. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 chips at $40 each, $40,000, plus 30,000 probation days. Like a willow that bends but never splits its trunk, one chip holds one identity.
